headline: Last session: Indian stock market extended its four-week rally as Sensex and Nifty hit nine-month highs.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Record FII buying helped the Indian market extend its four-week rally to nine-month highs.
Global AI sell-off and Fed rate hike signals created brief volatility earlier in the week.
Surging Brent oil prices contributed to a 60% surge in India's October oil and gas import bill.
Auto and banking sector buying supported market recoveries during trading sessions.
whatHappening: Chalet Hotels announced a ₹3,500 crore capex plan spanning over three years.
Reliance Brands reported a 3.8% rise in FY26 revenue to ₹3,390.9 crore with narrowing losses.
Mahindra Last Mile Mobility is planning an IPO within 18 months to finance expansion.
Aluminium product manufacturers requested zero import duty on raw metal ahead of the Budget.
summary:
Markets are closed today, Sunday, 22 November 2026, and will reopen on Monday, 23 November.
In recent trading, Sensex and Nifty extended a 4-week rally to hit 9-month highs behind record FII buying.
Corporate developments include Chalet Hotels' ₹3,500 crore capex plan and Reliance Brands narrowing its net losses.
